entities.summary: Henryk Petrich is a former Polish amateur boxer, who won the Light Heavyweight bronze medal at the 1988 Seoul Olympic games. Petrich also won bronze medal at the 1986 World Championships in Reno and silver medal at the 1987 European Championships in Turin. He's eight-time Polish champion.
